# Kalibrado Systems — one-pager

**Who it is for.** Metro Manila SMB manufacturers (icp: smb-mfg) running manual
inventory on stock cards and spreadsheets.

**The problem.** Manual counts drift. Purchasing reorders from memory. Audits
eat weekends.

**The offer (OFF-BUILD-STD).** A fixed-scope inventory build delivered in eight
weeks: barcode intake, guided cycle counts, reorder alerts and a BIR-ready
invoice export. Priced per the published price book [price:PB-2026-02].

**Why it holds up.** Under EOPT a registered invoice is mandatory for every
sale of ₱500 or more [ev:C-1] — the export is built to that rule. Market-rate
bookkeeping support runs ₱3,000 to ₱15,000 per month [ev:C-3]; the export cuts
the re-encoding hours that drive that bill.

**Next step.** A paid discovery sprint scoped to one production line.
